Question Choices: Estimate 6.4 - 2.7 by rounding each number to the nearest whole number.
Hints: Round each operand to the requested place before subtracting.
Solution: Round each operand to the nearest whole number: 6.4 -> 6; 2.7 -> 3. Then subtract 6 - 3 = 3. The estimate is 3.
